device_timing.intermediate_values: Direct integer serialization supports bounded8..300 slider steps; only anchors300/150/8 and startup50 were captured, and physical intermediate timing is unmeasured.

operator_restore.extra_apply: Ten Applies are consistent with the planned nine plus restore. Identical payloads prevent uniquely attributing each earlier burst.

linux_implementation.pointer: Cinnamon/GNOME gsettings speed; Resa level1..11 maps linearly to -1..1, distinct from Windows table.
linux_implementation.wheel: Optional /usr/bin/imwheel -d -b45 with owned ~/.imwheelrc. Only explicit Apply starts it, and Resa stops its own child on quit.

limits: No claim that absence of a candidate difference proves every possible report or host action; VirtualBox records are shortened.
Double Click Speed is the vendor label; retained nameFIRE_TIME does not establish a Linux desktop double-click threshold. No SetDoubleClickTime call was found in the focused retained functions.
Linux pointer/wheel controls require host support; Windows level tables are not Linux gain calibration.
No hardware writes, Windows execution or desktop setting changes were performed during this analysis.
